mistakes.fix_suggestion: Reroute the trace to use 45° or 90° angles instead. If the acute angle is unavoidable, add a teardrop at the junction to eliminate the sharp corner.

mistakes.title: Thermal imbalance may cause tombstoning
mistakes.explanation: R2 pad 2 is connected to copper zone (GND), while the other pad is not. The thermal mass difference can cause tombstoning: the pad on the zone heats slower, so solder melts unevenly.
mistakes.fix_suggestion: Add thermal relief to the zone connection, or add copper to balance thermal mass on both pads. Consider adding thermal spokes or reducing zone connection width.
